title: Spectacular!
overview: A high school choir is fading in popularity, as it continues to lose most of its' members one by one. A wannabe rock singer is convinced to join the choir, in hopes of winning the upcoming competition and cash prize.

file.itemTitle: The Totally Rad Show 123: Tronverse - San Diego Comic Con Spectacular with James Cameron's Avatar, Alice in Wonderland, Kick-Ass, Jonah Hex, Marvel Ultimate Alliance 2, Where the Wild Things Are, V, and much more!
